retrievalProfile.description: A first-person perspective from a car dashboard looking out at a dense traffic jam under a hazy, neon-lit urban sky.

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, low-angle POV shot from inside a vehicle's cabin, featuring a detailed dashboard and steering wheel in the foreground, looking through the windshield at a line of cars with glowing red taillights, all enveloped in a smoky, purple-tinted haze with vibrant neon typography floating in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground dashboard framing the lower third of the composition
Midground traffic line creating a horizontal barrier
Background haze and smoke obscuring the horizon
Neon pink glow from the title reflecting on the windshield area
coreInvariants: Red taillight glow from cars ahead
Desaturated cool-toned interior vs. warm neon accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The dashboard and steering wheel occupy the bottom 40%, while the traffic jam fills the center, and typography dominates the top 30%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central car's bright red taillights and the large glowing title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the steering wheel, move up to the red taillights, and finally rest on the glowing neon title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, hazy areas in the upper corners and the shadowed cabin interior.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues and grays for the car interior and night sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant neon pink for the main title glow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark, desaturated interior and the luminous, saturated light sources.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses heavy, italicized, condensed sans-serif with an inner glow
Secondary text uses wide-tracked, extended sans-serif
Artist name uses a high-contrast modern serif with thin hairlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Outer glow effect on the main title to simulate neon light
Extreme horizontal tracking on the subtitle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy condensed italics and wide-spaced extended blocks.

candidateDirections.reason: For the heavy condensed display title
For the high-contrast serif artist name

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a POV shot from a car's interior dashboard looking at a line of cars in a traffic jam at night. Include heavy smoke/haze and glowing red taillights. The color palette should be dark blue and gray with magenta/pink atmospheric lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-line condensed italicized title in the upper center with a vibrant pink outer glow. Add a wide-spaced extended sans-serif subtitle below it. Place a high-contrast serif artist name above the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective from the driver's seat?
Does the title have a pink neon glow?
Are the taillights of the cars in front glowing red?
Is the atmosphere hazy or smoky?

mustRedesign: Specific brand names on the dashboard
The hanging clothing item (replace with generic air freshener or dice)

avoid: Cluttered typography that obscures the center

postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography is centered and balanced
Check that the pink glow doesn't wash out the white text
Confirm the red taillights are the primary light source in the midground
recipe.reuseFormula: POV Car Interior + Traffic Jam + Hazy Night + Neon Typography Overlay
